resources.string: The app needs this permission to enable this feature. Please grant it!
This feature requires a few permissions to function correctly. Please grant them in the next step.
The app needs Camera access so you can take photos or record videos.
The app needs Microphone access to record your voice.
The app needs Location access to provide you with the most accurate services.
The app needs access to your photos and media so you can upload or save files.
You previously denied this permission. To continue, please open Settings and grant it manually.
Several essential permissions have been permanently denied. Please open Settings and allow access.
Camera access is blocked. Please open Settings, go to Permissions, and allow Camera access.
Microphone access is blocked. Please open Settings, go to Permissions, and allow Microphone access.
Location access is blocked. Please open Settings and select "Allow all the time" or "Allow only while using the app".
Storage access is blocked. Please open Settings to grant this permission.
